dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is extracting Markdown/JSON, tables, formulas, images, and layout from PDFs and document images, and the artifact only provides PaddleOCR CLI usage for that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Commands are user-directed and scoped to explicit URLs, local file paths, page ranges, and output paths, but the skill should more plainly warn that document contents may be processed by a remote API and may be sensitive.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation declares the paddleocr package via uv, the paddleocr binary, and PADDLEOCR_ACCESS_TOKEN; no extra scripts, hidden executables, or obfuscated install behavior are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: An API token and remote OCR processing are proportionate for hosted document parsing, but the examples include invoices and financial reports, so users should apply data-handling care.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: There is no evidence of persistence, privilege escalation, background workers, broad filesystem indexing, credential harvesting, destructive actions, or automatic execution.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The artifact does direct users to parse documents through paddleocr api and optionally save results/resources, which is expected for this skill; the lack of explicit confidentiality, retention, and third-party-processing guidance is a privacy note rather than evidence of hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[SSD-3] expected: Showing extracted OCR content is central to the skill, and the instruction allows summarization with full results on explicit request; however, users should avoid displaying full text from sensitive documents unless needed.
llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the PaddleOCR CLI package and are comfortable using a PaddleOCR access token with a hosted document-parsing API. Do not process confidential, regulated, customer, legal, financial, or identity documents unless your data-sharing and retention requirements allow it, and avoid asking the agent to display full extracted text when a summary or redacted output is sufficient.
llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward PaddleOCR document-parsing helper, with privacy caveats around sending and displaying potentially sensitive documents.
